transcript: I think the AI-centered utopia lacks a lot of human traits that I would look for in a society that I would want to live in. uh i think the basis of ai and generally its usage cases are much too machine-like for me to be really enamored with it or want to live there the rule of law utopia i think would be the best one as everyone would have a place and it's clear what would happen and what would not happen as the laws would be followed a futurist utopia i put it second because science and innovation could lead to a society in which innovation and bettering people's lives is very paramount so i think that's very good and then the rest i generally thought were just in the middle and rank them in a sort of way that's maybe not something that pops first into my mind in terms of generally what I would want to live in or where I would want to be but it's not necessarily bad either it's just sort of whatever so that's generally how I sort of rank them they all have sort of the pros and cons, but the rule of law would obviously be first for me. And I think that generally one society that focuses on AI and sort of just AI is not something where I would look forward to.
